lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਅਵਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥੨੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: mukat padaarath paaeeai thaak na avaghat ghaat ||231||
lines.translation: He obtains the treasure of liberation, and the difficult road to the Lord is not blocked. ||231||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਨੑਿ ਉਠਾਈ ਪੋਟਲੀ ਕਿਥੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਘਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)nhi uthaaee potalee kithai va(n)njaa ghat ||2||
lines.translation: I am so accustomed to walking in the ways of the world. I have tied and picked up the bundle; where can I go to throw it away? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਆਧੀ ਘਰੀ ਆਧੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਆਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ek ghaRee aadhee gharee aadhee hoo(n) te aadh ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, whether is is for an hour, half an hour, or half of that,

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਗੋਸਟੇ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੋ ਲਾਭ ॥੨੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatan setee gosate jo keene so laabh ||232||
lines.translation: whatever it is, it is worthwhile to speak with the Holy. ||232||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਭਾਂਗ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਸੁਰਾ ਪਾਨਿ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਖਾਂਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer bhaa(n)g maachhulee suraa paan jo jo praanee khaa(n)hi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, those mortals who consume marijuana, fish and wine

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕੀਏ ਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੨੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: teerath barat nem keee te sabhai rasaatal jaa(n)hi ||233||
lines.translation: - no matter what pilgrimages, fasts and rituals they follow, they will all go to hell. ||233||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਉ ਲੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: neeche loin kar rahau le saajan ghat maahi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I keep my eyes lowered, and enshrine my Friend within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਖੇਲਉ ਪੀਅ ਸਉ ਕਿਸੀ ਲਖਾਵਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ras khelau pee sau kisee lakhaavau naahi ||234||
lines.translation: I enjoy all pleasures with my Beloved, but I do not let anyone else know. ||234||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਜਾਮ ਚਉਸਠਿ ਘਰੀ ਤੁਅ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath jaam chausath gharee tu nirakhat rahai jeeu ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, every hour, my soul continues to look to You, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਦੇਖਉ ਪੀਉ ॥੨੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: neeche loin kiu karau sabh ghat dekhau peeu ||235||
lines.translation: Why should I keep my eyes lowered? I see my Beloved in every heart. ||235||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਪੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਕਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sakhee pee mahi jeeu basai jee mahi basai k peeu ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my companions: my soul dwells in my Beloved, and my Beloved dwells in my soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪੀਉ ਬੂਝਉ ਨਹੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਿ ਪੀਉ ॥੨੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu peeu boojhau nahee ghat mahi jeeu k peeu ||236||
lines.translation: I realize that there is no difference between my soul and my Beloved; I cannot tell whether my soul or my Beloved dwells in my heart. ||236||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਾਮਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਕਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer baaman guroo hai jagat kaa bhagatan kaa gur naahi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the Brahmin may be the guru of the world, but he is not the Guru of the devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਝਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਕੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੂਆ ਚਾਰਉ ਬੇਦਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: arajh urajh kai pach mooaa chaarau bedahu maahi ||237||
lines.translation: He rots and dies in the perplexities of the four Vedas. ||237||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰੀ ਹਾਥੀ ਚੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har hai khaa(n)d ret mahi bikharee haathee chunee na jaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord is like sugar, scattered in the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਕੀਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer gur bhalee bujhaaee keetee hoi kai khaai ||238||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the Guru has given me this sublime understanding: become an ant, and feed on it. ||238||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jau tuhi saadh pira(n)m kee sees kaat kar goi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, then cut off your head, and make it into a ball.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: khelat khelat haal kar jo kichh hoi ta hoi ||239||
lines.translation: Lose yourself in the play of it, and then whatever will be, will be. ||239||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਕੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jau tuhi saadh pira(n)m kee paake setee khel ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, play it with someone with committment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਸਰਸਉਂ ਪੇਲਿ ਕੈ ਨਾ ਖਲਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: kaachee sarasau(n) pel kai naa khal bhaee na tel ||240||
lines.translation: Pressing the unripe mustard seeds produces neither oil nor flour. ||240||

lines.gurmukhi: ਢੂੰਢਤ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਚੀਨਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoo(n)dhat dolahi a(n)dh gat ar cheenat naahee sa(n)t ||
lines.translation: Searching, the mortal stumbles like a blind person, and does not recognize the Saint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥੨੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahi naamaa kiu paaeeai bin bhagatahu bhagava(n)t ||241||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, how can one obtain the Lord God, without His devotee? ||241||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: har so heeraa chhaad kai karahi aan kee aas ||
lines.translation: Forsaking the Diamond of the Lord, the mortals put their hopes in another.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਦੋਜਕ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ॥੨੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: te nar dojak jaahige sat bhaakhai ravidaas ||242||
lines.translation: Those people shall go to hell; Ravi Daas speaks the Truth. ||242||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਕਰੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jau grihu karahi ta dharam kar naahee ta kar bairaag ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, if you live the householder's life, then practice righteousness; otherwise, you might as well retire from the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਡੋ ਅਭਾਗੁ ॥੨੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: bairaagee ba(n)dhan karai taa ko bado abhaag ||243||
lines.translation: If someone renounces the world, and then gets involved in worldly entanglements, he shall suffer terrible misfortune. ||243||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok sekh phareed ke ||
lines.translation: Saloks Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਹਾੜੈ ਧਨ ਵਰੀ ਸਾਹੇ ਲਏ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit dihaaRai dhan varee saahe lae likhaai ||
lines.translation: The day of the bride's wedding is pre-ordained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਕੁ ਜਿ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: malak j ka(n)nee suneedaa muhu dekhaale aai ||
lines.translation: On that day, the Messenger of Death, of whom she had only heard, comes and shows its face.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਦੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਕਢੀਐ ਹਡਾ ਕੂ ਕੜਕਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ji(n)d nimaanee kadheeai hadaa koo kaRakaai ||
lines.translation: It breaks the bones of the body and pulls the helpless soul out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੇ ਲਿਖੇ ਨ ਚਲਨੀ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਕੂੰ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahe likhe na chalanee ji(n)doo koo(n) samajhaai ||
lines.translation: That pre-ordained time of marriage cannot be avoided. Explain this to your soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਦੁ ਵਹੁਟੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਰਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ji(n)d vahutee maran var lai jaasee paranaai ||
lines.translation: The soul is the bride, and death is the groom. He will marry her and take her away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਜੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapan hathee jol kai kai gal lagai dhaai ||
lines.translation: After the body sends her away with its own hands, whose neck will it embrace?

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਪੁਰਸਲਾਤ ਕੰਨੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaalahu nikee purasalaat ka(n)nee na sunee aai ||
lines.translation: The bridge to hell is narrower than a hair; haven't you heard of it with your ears?

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿੜੀ ਪਵੰਦੀਈ ਖੜਾ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kiRee pava(n)deeee khaRaa na aap muhaai ||1||
lines.translation: Fareed, the call has come; be careful now - don't let yourself be robbed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਚਲਾਂ ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਭਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa dar daravesee gaakhaRee chalaa(n) duneeaa(n) bhat ||
lines.translation: Fareed, it is so difficult to become a humble Saint at the Lord's Door.
